funds.directEquityBasis: CPP Investments documents Infrastructure as an active internal direct-investment program that acquires and holds significant ownership interests in essential operating infrastructure. It is an evergreen pension investment program rather than a third-party commingled fund and is therefore included as a PROGRAM_EXCEPTION.

northAmericaQualification.rationale: CPP Investments' annual reporting attributes the continuing investment in 407 International Inc., operator of Ontario's 407 ETR toll road, to the Infrastructure program, establishing current direct-equity deployment in Canada.

snapshot.investmentStrategy: Evergreen global direct infrastructure program within CPP Investments' Real Assets platform, investing in essential transportation, digital, utility and social-infrastructure businesses.

evidence.title: Infrastructure
evidence.evidenceSummary: The official strategy page identifies Infrastructure as a current CPP Investments direct-investment program focused on essential infrastructure businesses and supports its evergreen internal-program structure and non-energy infrastructure remit.

evidence.title: CPP Investments 2026 Annual Report
evidence.evidenceLabel: Current program and Canadian holding attribution
evidence.evidenceSummary: The annual report presents Infrastructure as an active investment program and attributes the continuing 407 International Inc. investment to it, supporting current lifecycle and verified North American deployment.

funds.repoDispositionRationale: FUND-058 matches the documented Infrastructure program and is reconciled exactly once. A correction is proposed because official program and annual-report evidence establish current North American deployment and support separating Infrastructure's transportation, digital, utility and social-infrastructure remit from CPP Investments' separately documented Sustainable Energies program.

funds.directEquityBasis: CPP Investments documents Sustainable Energies as an active internal direct-investment program deploying equity across renewable power, conventional energy, energy infrastructure and transition-oriented businesses. It is an evergreen pension investment program rather than a separately raised third-party fund and is therefore included as a PROGRAM_EXCEPTION.

northAmericaQualification.rationale: CPP Investments' annual reporting attributes the continuing Pattern Energy investment to Sustainable Energies. Pattern Energy owns and operates renewable-energy assets across the United States, Canada and Mexico, establishing current North American direct-equity deployment.

snapshot.investmentStrategy: Evergreen global direct-equity energy program investing across renewable power, conventional energy, energy infrastructure and energy-transition businesses.

evidence.title: Sustainable Energies
evidence.evidenceSummary: The official strategy page identifies Sustainable Energies as a current direct-investment program spanning renewable power, conventional energy, energy infrastructure and transition opportunities, supporting program identity, direct-equity scope and evergreen lifecycle.

evidence.title: CPP Investments 2026 Annual Report
evidence.evidenceLabel: Current program and North American energy-holding attribution
evidence.evidenceSummary: The annual report presents Sustainable Energies as an active investment program and attributes the continuing Pattern Energy investment to it, supporting current lifecycle and verified deployment through renewable-energy assets in the United States, Canada and Mexico.

funds.repoDispositionRationale: The repository contains no separate row for CPP Investments' documented Sustainable Energies evergreen direct-investment program. It is commercially and organizationally distinct from Infrastructure and therefore warrants a proposed new program-exception record under the existing canonical manager.

notes: CPP Investments does not market Infrastructure or Sustainable Energies as third-party closed-end funds; both are included solely as documented evergreen pension direct-investment program exceptions.
A generic global remit was not treated as sufficient. Each program qualified through a current North American holding attributed to that specific program in primary annual-report evidence.

No separately raised commitments, final close, fund-level AUM or independently disclosed program capital base was identified for either program, so size remains unclassified and sizeAsOf remains null.
Historical Power & Renewables and Energy & Resources labels were treated as predecessor components or aliases of Sustainable Energies rather than separate current commercial vehicles.
No feeder, parallel fund, sleeve, sidecar or separately capitalized co-investment vehicle was identified for inclusion.
The sole supplied repository row, FUND-058, is matched exactly once; no repository-only record remains.
